hypotheses.title: Inherited operational memory layer for repeat/near-repeat web tasks
hypotheses.user_problem: Browser agents re-pay full exploration cost (actions, model calls, tokens, latency) on repeat or near-repeat tasks already solved before.
validated_building_blocks: cumulative store + provenance/confidence fields + exact replay + entry-state reset (Graph G-H1)
blind content-addressed fragment retrieval with expected-UNKNOWN discipline (Graph G-H2)
oracle-equalized iterative replay policy carrying composed depth (Graph G-H2/G-H3 E2)
multi-step login procedure packaging as first-class reusable unit (Graph G-H3 E2, G-H4 R3)
V31 closed-class descriptor/query equipment (Graph G-H4) — adopted as equipment only, no quantitative transfer claims (fresh instrument spent)

SGDR-style fused task-goal + current-state-summary candidate scoring for free-form goals in the NL-consumer regime (Intel cycle-1 clean-room reproduction, PoC ceiling): hard@1 36/74 vs task-only 25/74 (11 wins/0 reversals); wrong-context fusion falls back to baseline (24/74); fewer novel actions at equal-or-higher success vs task-only retrieval (39 vs 42 literal; 36 vs 42 paraphrase). Lexical-hash embedder + deterministic summarizer configuration only; binding forbidden wordings apply (no GENERALIZATION language; no unqualified 'beats incumbent'; regime caveat on combined novel-action totals; no login/pager-improvement claims)
unvalidated_assumptions: inheritance survives a real LLM consumer (all accepted evidence is scripted deterministic consumers)

fused addressing serves free-form natural-language goals END-TO-END inside the product loop (audited only at PoC scale in an isolated harness; neural embedder, LLM summarizer and 10x-library adaptations untested)
savings are material in tokens/model-calls/wall-clock with an LLM in the loop
known failure modes (category goals, >3 distinct fragments, cross-site transfer) stay contained in declared scope
hypotheses.expected_operational_benefit: On repeat/near-repeat tasks: large reductions in browser actions, model calls/tokens and latency at non-inferior success; reused-action share dominates the action mix.
hypotheses.differentiation: Subgoal-addressable executable fragments with empirical validation statistics, provenance and freshness metadata consumed by an external model-agnostic layer; the free-form-goal front door is now an independently validated external mechanism rather than home-grown addressing — bounded hypothesis from audit-qualified survey, not a novelty claim.
hypotheses.conceptual_architecture: Producer runs grow validated store -> fused task+state-summary candidate scoring over auto-derived descriptions (V31 canonicalization as preprocessing) selects fragments/procedures for subgoals -> consumer LLM executes memory-led with exploration fallback and explicit UNKNOWN reporting -> anchored completion predicate equalized across arms -> outcomes written back with provenance (calibration deferred).
hypotheses.biggest_uncertainty: Whether the scripted-setup advantage survives a real LLM consumer end-to-end without memory-induced wrong actions, stale-fragment traps or addressing misses under genuine goal rewording.
hypotheses.evidence_needed: Beta PB-001 outcome vs cold-agent and trajectory-RAG baselines under the preregistered win rule.
